label: Regular-open priority direction control
term: proper-part chains and whole-first grounding control
definition: PriorityControl reuses GunkCertificate (definition 416dfd08-eb27-5d9a-b2cd-fc8c7a7c2981): nonzero Heyting-regular real opens with their existing complete Boolean full-fusion profile. Every starting positive region has an injective Nat-indexed descending strict-part chain; strict parthood and its converse are both non-WF. Reversing a chain rejects the same oriented sequence, not every sequence. A designated greatest region supplies a different whole-first star graph on the same carrier, with that region as its unique graph-relative source; this graph is WF but omits some converse-parthood edges. The Boolean region algebra has no Mathlib IsAtom, while Set Bool has both Mathlib IsAtomic and IsAtomistic. These are mathematical order claims, not actual dependence.
